description: Securely read from and write to authorized workspace directories.

list_directory.description: List the contents of a directory in the workspace.

path.description: Single path to list. Paths are automatically resolved relative to your workspace root. This tool does NOT support native batching; for multiple paths, emit multiple tool call tags.

read_file.description: Read the content of a file in the workspace.

path.description: Single path to read. Paths are automatically resolved relative to your workspace root. This tool does NOT support native batching; for multiple files, emit multiple tool call tags.

write_file.description: Write content to a file in the workspace.

path.description: Single path to write. Paths are automatically resolved relative to your workspace root. This tool does NOT support native batching; for multiple files, emit multiple tool call tags.

content.description: The exact string content to write. Keep content under 800 characters. For longer output, break into multiple write_file calls with separate paths (e.g. report_part1.md, report_part2.md). For JSON files, this MUST be a JSON-formatted string, NOT a JSON object.

append_file.description: Append content to an existing file in the workspace.

path.description: Single path to append to. The file must already exist. Paths are automatically resolved relative to your workspace root.

content.description: The content to append to the file. Keep content under 1200 characters per call. Use this to build large reports incrementally — start with write_file and continue with append_file.
